name: card
title: Card
description: Card parts: a titled card renders as a section labelled by its title, with an eyebrow, a top-end action slot, a heading level on the title and card, dashed or bare surfaces.
docs: A `Card` renders `<section>`; once it holds a `CardTitle` it gets `aria-labelledby` pointing at the title, so it is a named region. Give the title `headingLevel` to make it a heading. `CardEyebrow` sits above the title, `CardAction` at the top end of `CardHeader`. The header is a container (`@container/card-header`): the action sits beside the title, which keeps at least 8rem, once the header has 17rem of content (a card of about 20rem), and wraps below the title, start-aligned, in a narrower card. Its buttons wrap among themselves rather than overflow. `surface` is `card` (default), `dashed` or `none`. To keep a card out of the landmarks (a card per list item), pass `render={<div />}` or `render={<li />}`.
